Description
Wycombe Abbey School Hong Kong (WASHK), a sister school of the UK’s renowned Wycombe Abbey, is a leading British international school for students aged 5 to 18 (Year 1 to Year 13). Established in 2019, the school combines Wycombe Abbey’s 130 years of British academic excellence with innovative learning.
WASHK is committed to strengthening core disciplines, including STEM subjects, English, and Mandarin proficiency, while fostering future-ready skills through dynamic modules in entrepreneurship, leadership, and digital literacy.
The school prides itself on cultivating self-motivated learners driven by intellectual curiosity and intrinsic passion, empowering them to excel academically and develop as future-ready leaders.
